resources.string: Write these words down in order. They can restore this identity and are secret immediately. Setup is not complete until Veil confirms encrypted identity creation.
Type up to the first four letters, then select the matching word.
For privacy, recovery words are excluded from screen readers and Android autofill.
That word does not match. Check your written backup.
Those words are not a valid recovery phrase. Review the final words and try again.

These words can restore this identity and must remain secret. Veil will encrypt the identity with Android Keystore and read it back before continuing. If setup is interrupted, reopen Veil and check whether the identity was stored; discard this copy only if Veil reports that no identity exists.

Veil will verify the existing backup, encrypt the restored identity with Android Keystore, and read it back before continuing. If setup fails, your existing backup remains valid; no recovery material leaves this protected screen.
Keep Veil open while Android secures and verifies this identity. If Veil closes, reopen it and let the local account check finish before starting setup again.
No recovery material was returned to the app interface. Close this screen and start identity setup again.
